description: Add a site the Stunt Double Index does not track yet and give it a first score. Runs light HTTP probes (robots.txt, llms.txt, structured data, sitemaps) in under a minute; include_agent_sessions also starts live agent sessions, which may queue behind a shared daily budget. The site becomes public on the leaderboard. Public domains only; robots.txt opt-outs are respected; a tracked site is not rescored (use request_index_rerun). Then read get_index_report, and poll list_index_sessions with the run_id if sessions started.

domain.description: The site to score, e.g. "docs.example.com". A full URL is fine: protocol, path and a leading www. are dropped.

include_agent_sessions.description: Also start the light set of live agent sessions after the probes. Defaults to false: probes only.

name: request_index_score

agent_sessions.description: enqueued when the agent sessions started; deferred or retrying when they are queued for later today; probes_only when none were asked for; off when sessions are unavailable or nothing ran.

message.description: What happened and what to do next, ready to relay.

report_url.description: The public Index report page for the site, to link a person to.

run_id.description: The scoring run, when one was created. Pass it to list_index_sessions.

status.description: scored when the Index scored the site now; already_tracked when it was on the Index already and nothing ran; opted_out when the site asked not to be scored.

title: Request Index score
